name: crosspost-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin: cross-post one canonical post to 8 channels (LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, X, Remember, Brunch, Naver Blog, Instagram)

scripts.check: npm test && for f in $(find scripts -name '*.mjs' -type f); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in $(find scripts skills -name '*.sh' -type f); do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
